purpose: Pre-register a held-out extension of the frozen METR-LA/PEMS-BAY H12 MambaTSv3 AutoCon comparison with STGCN-style, TimesNet, and Mamba2 baselines that were previously validation-only.
research_question: Does the already frozen MambaTSv3 AutoCon prediction-connected fusion candidate remain non-inferior to newly registered graph-temporal and modern Mamba/periodic baselines on held-out METR-LA and PEMS-BAY H12?
evidence_boundary: This is an unapproved protocol draft. No job from it may be launched, and no new held-out metric may be read, until a human approval sidecar binds its exact SHA-256.
claim_boundary: If approved and passed, this extension would support only non-graph MambaTSv3 candidate comparisons on METR-LA/PEMS-BAY H12. The local STGCN-style baseline is not an external-code bitwise reproduction; no universal, graph-aware, causal-AutoCon, or hardware-independent claim follows.

required_before_launch: verify dataset and adjacency fingerprints plus exact 46-job expansion
confirm that candidate hyperparameters remain fixed and no test result can select a model
approve the exact plan SHA-256 in a separate launch sidecar
execute all phases from one immutable source snapshot and read test metrics only after strict validation

selection_contract.freeze_rule: The candidate architecture and AutoCon lambda were fixed before this extension; selection only verifies executable provenance and may not use baseline or held-out values.

confirmation_contract.test_read_gate: Read test metrics only after every registered phase validator succeeds.
confirmation_contract.independence_note: Seed-level paired contrasts are the uncertainty unit; forecast windows and channels are not inferential replicates.

capacity_fairness_contract.common_public_budget: All arms share data loader, chronological split, features, sequence length, horizon, epochs, patience, optimizer, scheduler, batch and normalization.
capacity_fairness_contract.candidate_boundary: Only MambaTSv3AutoCon receives its frozen prediction-connected representation-fusion flag and AutoCon objective.
capacity_fairness_contract.stgcn_boundary: STGCN receives the safe adjacency contract only and no AutoCon path; it is the local canonical-style graph-temporal comparator.
capacity_fairness_contract.external_baseline_boundary: TimesNet and Mamba2 receive no candidate-only AutoCon, representation-fusion or graph flags.

accuracy_claim_contract.boundary: The two new primary comparator families use a Bonferroni-adjusted one-sided interval; TimesNet remains descriptive in this extension because its original release was not selected as primary.

phases.name: selection_fusion_candidate_validation
phases.purpose: Validation-only executable check of the previously frozen MambaTSv3 AutoCon fusion candidate.

phases.name: confirmatory_fusion_candidate_test
phases.purpose: Frozen MambaTSv3 AutoCon fusion candidate held-out phase.

phases.name: confirmatory_stgcn_baseline_test
phases.purpose: Frozen local STGCN-style graph-temporal held-out baseline using the registered adjacency NPZ contract.

phases.name: confirmatory_timesnet_mamba2_baselines_test
phases.purpose: Frozen TimesNet and Mamba2 held-out baselines without candidate-only AutoCon or graph settings.

statistical_gate.multiplicity: Bonferroni across the two primary comparator families
statistical_gate.interpretation: A primary cell is non-inferior only if its Bonferroni-adjusted one-sided paired upper MSE ratio is <=1.02.
statistical_gate.small_n_warning: Five seeds remain modest and do not support universal claims.

resource_contract.efficiency_claim_gate: Report prediction-only speed only for named comparators whose registered accuracy gate passes; never use training wall time as inference throughput.
